name: Maximum cardinality of a nondividing subset of {1, 2, ..., n}.
comment: A set is called nondividing if no element divides the sum of any nonempty subset of the other elements.
link: Christian Sievers, Table of n, a(n) for n = 0..100
Eric Weisstein's World of Mathematics, Nondividing Set.
example: a(65) = 8 because 8 is the maximal cardinality of a nondividing subset of {1, 2, ..., 65}.  Two different subsets have cardinality 8:
